declared_originator: Jupiter Hudson / WisdomLoveThePoet / Jupiter 8 / Joseph Q Hudson
purpose: Provide a shared index that humans can read and software can parse while preserving context, uncertainty, provenance boundaries, and human self-definition.

interpretation_policy.provenance_note: Integrity, signatures, timestamps, version history, and public evidence can strengthen provenance. No single field independently proves authorship, ownership, or legal enforceability.

artifacts.title: CMB Polyglot Firewall Specification

artifacts.title: CMB // The Unburned Signal Protocol

artifacts.declared_meaning: Public manifesto for CMB-Z13, defining thirteen zodiac-inspired software-language lenses plus the Guardian Modes teaching layer while preserving human authority and rejecting deterministic classification.

artifacts.title: CMB-Z13 Machine Registry
artifacts.declared_meaning: Machine-readable representation of the CMB-Z13 mapping, symbolic vectors, Guardian Modes aliases, reasoning pipeline, invariants, and epistemic boundaries.

artifacts.title: CMB - 12 Principles for Human Agency in Automated Systems
artifacts.declared_meaning: Compressed public entry point to the Global Advocacy Charter; it acknowledges existing legal and scholarly foundations and states CMB's translation-layer contribution.

artifacts.declared_meaning: States what CMB does not claim to have invented, identifies relevant law and scholarship, and defines the narrower contribution CMB claims.

artifacts.title: CMB Provenance ↔ C2PA Interoperability Plan

artifacts.title: Independent Review Requested
artifacts.declared_meaning: Publicly documents the current lack of independent certification and defines a narrow, reproducible external review scope.

artifacts.declared_meaning: Strict schema for CMB-EDU envelopes. It records declared context as human-declared, forbids machine-inferred state in the v1 envelope, and encodes deny-by-default privacy declarations without claiming external enforcement.

artifacts.title: CMB Agent Registry v1
artifacts.declared_meaning: Canonical CMB-ADP-1 registry for relevance-first discovery, attribution-preserving recommendation, bounded summaries, and machine-readable knowledge relationships.

artifacts.title: CMB Agent Discovery Card v1
artifacts.declared_meaning: Compact CMB-ADP-1 discovery card for agent-facing capability discovery. It does not claim MCP or A2A protocol conformance.

artifacts.title: CMB Agent Discovery Protocol v1
artifacts.declared_meaning: Defines CMB-ADP-1 discovery, recommendation, citation, HTTP reference behavior, standards boundaries, anti-spam constraints, and Recovery expectations.

artifacts.title: CMB Agent Registry v1 Schema
artifacts.declared_meaning: Schema contract for the canonical CMB-ADP-1 registry, including explicit trust-preserving distribution boundaries.

artifacts.title: HARMONI // Perfect-Play Epistemics
artifacts.kind: code-art manifesto and epistemic triage model
artifacts.declared_meaning: Code-art architecture for routing patterns through questions, tests, and evidence while treating unknown or value-sensitive states as a reason to disclose uncertainty and defer consequential meaning to authorized humans.

artifacts.title: CMB Creator Provenance Protocol
artifacts.declared_meaning: Human-readable protocol separating creator-documented genealogy, declared intellectual influences, symbolic references, and cryptographic provenance without converting one category into proof of another.

artifacts.title: CMB Creator Provenance Registry v1
artifacts.declared_meaning: Strict machine-readable separation of historical context, authorship declaration, intellectual influence, symbolic meaning, cryptographic provenance, and privacy boundaries.

artifacts.title: CMB Creator Provenance v1 Schema
artifacts.declared_meaning: Draft 2020-12 schema that constrains the canonical creator-provenance record so genealogy remains unverified historical context, symbolic references remain non-scientific, and private family-tree source material remains unpublished.

artifacts.title: Case Study 001 - Google Generative Narrative Misclassification
artifacts.declared_meaning: Documents a user-observed Google generative-search narrative, preserves the screenshot fingerprint, separates generated claims from verified evidence, and defines revision criteria without alleging malicious intent or system-wide behavior.
